system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.14.1 - Combat Links. Linking a Triad (3 Champions of a High Elemental triad, e.g. Fire-Water-Ice or Air-Earth-Light) or a Circle (all 6 Champions) together for mutual bonuses: shared Resistance Rolls, Awareness, Intuition/DB, Strength/Offensive Bonus, injuries and Power Points pooled and split across the link, mental communication, temporarily swapping main elements, group Haste, and ultimately designating an Aether/Nether Champion (or, at the top, a Champion of the Sphere able to draw on any of the eight elements at will) who draws power from the whole Circle to cast. Special notes from the source: a Triad is one Elemental Champion of each of the three High Elemental Materials in a single elemental triad; a Circle is 6 Elemental Champions, one per High Element; an Elemental Champion cannot be a member of a Circle and a Triad at the same time; and while these bonuses are cumulative with other effects, most are not cumulative with themselves (you can't be under two Bond of Strength II spells at once).
Caster is aware of any active combat links within the area of effect.
Caster sends a mental message to the members of his Triad or Circle.
Members of the Triad have their Resistance Rolls boosted by +15.
Members of the Triad share each other's perceptions in a non-distracting way. The Triad receives a +30 to Battle Awareness and +15 to general Awareness checks and Sense Ambush/Assassin checks.
Members of the Triad benefit from each other's intuition and foresight giving them all members a +15 to DB against all attacks.
Members of the Triad benefit from each other's strength giving them all a +15 to their Offensive Bonuses and Strength maneuvers.

Minor injuries done to a member of the Triad are shared with the members of the bond. Stunning, Hits, and Bleeding results are divided by three and assigned to all members of the Triad. All results are rounded down, so 2 rounds of stun will not affect the group and 5 rounds of stun will stun the entire group for 1 round.

The Power Points from each member of the Triad are added together to form a pool. Spells cast by any member are subtracted from this pool. Power Point multipliers therefore work differently for each member. Do not apply them to the pool; instead take the multiplier and divide the casting cost of the spell by the multiplier to determine the casting cost. When this spell ends, divide the Power Points left among each member of the Triad. Then those with Power Point multipliers can multiply these Power Points normally.
Members of the Triad can communicate mentally. When this spell is used, all members of the link can hear and participate as if having a conversation amongst themselves.

Allows the Elemental Champion to link to two other Elemental Champions of different elements within their Triad (Fire-Water-Ice or Air-Earth-Light). The link is completed when all three Champions successfully cast this spell. Once completed the link cannot be broken until the duration of this spell runs out. Spells 2-9 require that this Link be active for them to work.

Triad or Circle members can temporarily switch their main element for the duration of this spell. Members are restricted to elements represented by other members. (E.g., a Fire champion could temporarily switch his primary element to water, but could not switch to Air unless the Champion was a member of a Circle.)
Members of the Circle have their Resistance Rolls boosted by +30 to all RR's.
Members of the Circle share each other's perceptions. The Triad receives a +50 to Battle Awareness and +30 to general Awareness checks and Sense Ambush/Assassin.
Members of the Circle benefit from the other's intuition and foresight, giving them a +30 to DB against all attacks. This bonus is cumulative with other bonuses.
Members of the Circle benefit from each other's strength, giving them a +30 to all of his offensive bonuses and Strength maneuvers.

As Shared Injuries I, except this spell only affects Circles and all injuries have their results divided by six rounded down. So an attack that delivered 5 rounds of stun would not affect any member of the group. An attack that did six rounds of stun would stun every member of the group for one round.
As Shared Power I, except this spell affects Circles.
As Mental Bond I, except this spell affects Circles.
Members of the Triad or Circle are hasted for the duration.

Allows an Elemental Champion to link to five other Elemental Champions of different Elements. The link is complete when all of the Champions successfully cast this spell. Once completed, the link cannot be broken until the duration of this spell runs out. Spells 12-19 require that this Link be complete for them to work. Once this linking has begun, members of the Circle have 5 minutes to successfully cast this spell or the link fails.

The Shared Power spell must be in effect for this spell to be cast. When this spell is successfully cast by all of the members of the Circle, it allows them to specify a single Elemental Champion as a Champion of Nether or Aether. The Aether or Nether Champion's spells work as if his primary element is Aether or Nether depending on which element was chosen. If the Champion's bonded weapon delivers additional criticals those criticals change to Aether or Nether. Whenever the Aether or Nether Champion casts a spell it draws power from every member of the Circle. Subtract 20 power points from the pool every time the champion casts a spell, in addition to the normal casting costs.
As Aether/Nether Champion, except when the champion casts spells it only draws 10 power points from the pool.
As Aether/Nether Champion, except the Champion may change what type of elemental force his spells are using at will from among all eight elements.
